dye.en: It's going to have things on there, like emulsifiers, preservatives, additives, dyes and sweeteners.
dye.zh: 它里面会有些东西，比如乳化剂、防腐剂、添加剂、色素和甜味剂。

dye.en: This tree produced a red dye that was used in Europe for creating luxury textiles.
dye.zh: 这种树产一种红色染料，在欧洲被用来制作奢侈纺织品。

dying.en: To put it another way, that’s one person dying from starvation every 25 seconds.
dying.zh: 换句话说，这意味着每25秒就有一个人死于饥饿。

dying.en: And Claudia likes this tradition, imagining the children waiting on the stairs, dying for their presents.
dying.zh: Claudia 很喜欢这个传统，想象着孩子们在楼梯上等待，渴望得到他们的礼物。

dying.en: And that's the end of that. So we are hardwired to avoid ruin and just dying.
dying.zh: 那一切就结束了。所以我们天生就是为了避免毁灭和死亡。

dying.en: We use the phrase dying for informally when someone really wants something.
dying.zh: 我们在非正式场合使用 dying for 这个短语，表示某人非常想要某样东西。

dying.en: Early 1942 was particularly brutal, with an estimated 100,000 people dying from starvation every month.
dying.zh: 1942年初尤其残酷，估计每个月有10万民众死于饥饿。

dynamic.en: He's created his own software program that actually looks at every one of the 16 million loans Dynamic owns part of.
dynamic.zh: 他自己开发了一套软件程序，能够实际查看Dynamic公司持有的全部1600万笔贷款中的每一笔。

dynamic.en: This was all happening in a dynamic environment.
dynamic.zh: 这一切都是在一个不断变化的环境中发生的。

dynamic.en: But then I think it's everyone we come into contact with, that gives us the icing that gives us the shape that gives us the dynamic texture that makes us who we are.
dynamic.zh: 但我认为正是我们接触到的每一个人，给了我们糖霜，给了我们形状，给了我们那份塑造我们个性的质感。

dynamic.en: Well, we're heading to the trading floor of Dynamic Credit, where we have all of our mortgage and CDO analysts, our head trader, our CIO-- Jim Finkel runs this CDO shop, Dynamic Credit.
dynamic.zh: 好了，我们要前往 Dynamic Credit 的交易大厅，那里有我们所有的抵押贷款和 CDO 分析师、首席交易员、首席投资官——Jim Finkel 经营着这家 CDO 公司，Dynamic Credit。

dynamic.en: And it was into this world—a world of vast wealth, complicated family politics, and an increasingly urgent need for a younger, more dynamic leadership—that we find Mohammed bin Salman, MBS.
dynamic.zh: 正是在这样一个世界里——一个拥有巨额财富、复杂的家族政治以及对年轻、更有活力的领导层日益迫切需求的世界——我们迎来了穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼（MBS）。

dynamical.en: But it's funny how people latch on to single proclamations, but the reality is all of us are dynamical systems.
dynamical.zh: 但有趣的是，人们如何紧抓着单一的宣言不放，但现实是，我们所有人都是动态系统。
